appRepositories.appDescription:
Fix navigation: titles opened from bookmark folders landed under the folder

The Library tab mixed destination-based NavigationLinks (folders, stats,
downloads) with value-based title links; SwiftUI then pushed the title on the
wrong level, leaving the folder on top and the title behind 'Назад'. All
Library links are now value-based (LibraryRoute), and frame search uses a
navigation path instead of an isPresented destination.
